statement: A CVE tied to the actively exploited PaperCut zero-day in item 12 will be added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a dateAdded value between 2026-08-28 and 2026-09-25.
resolution: True if the CISA KEV catalog lists a PaperCut CVE with dateAdded in the 2026-08-28 to 2026-09-25 window, checked at the deadline via cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog.
failure_condition: No PaperCut CVE appears in the CISA KEV catalog with a dateAdded value in that window as of the deadline.

statement: At least one of the three CVSS 10.0 ServiceNow vulnerabilities in items 18 and 20 will be added to the CISA KEV catalog with a dateAdded value between 2026-08-28 and 2026-10-12.
resolution: True if the CISA KEV catalog lists a ServiceNow CVE matching these flaws with dateAdded in the 2026-08-28 to 2026-10-12 window, checked at the deadline.
failure_condition: No matching ServiceNow CVE appears in the CISA KEV catalog with dateAdded in that window as of the deadline.

statement: The FOMC will leave the federal funds target range unchanged at its scheduled meeting concluding 2026-09-16, despite the hawkish Jackson Hole remarks in items 53, 55, and 56.
resolution: True if the FOMC statement released 2026-09-16 at 2pm ET sets the same target range in effect entering the meeting, per federalreserve.gov or a wire report.
failure_condition: The 2026-09-16 FOMC statement shows any change, cut or hike, to the federal funds target range.

statement: A new, specifically named acquirer will submit or confirm a takeover offer for PayPal Holdings after the prior bid in item 59 reportedly collapsed, first reported between 2026-08-28 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: True if Reuters, Bloomberg, the Wall Street Journal, or a PayPal SEC filing names a new acquirer offer with a first-report date in that window, checked at the deadline.
failure_condition: No wire report or SEC filing names a new acquirer offer for PayPal Holdings within the window.

statement: USDA or FSIS will publish a Federal Register entry or formal notice implementing the ranch and farm self-processing policy in item 60, dated between 2026-08-28 and 2026-12-15.
resolution: True if federalregister.gov lists a matching USDA/FSIS entry with a publication date in that window, or USDA issues a press release confirming the rule, checked at the deadline.
failure_condition: No matching Federal Register entry or USDA/FSIS rule announcement appears within the window as of the deadline.

statement: The United States and Iran, or Israel and Iran, will announce a mutually acknowledged ceasefire or armistice in the war referenced in items 92, 97, and 100, first reported between 2026-08-28 and 2026-10-15.
resolution: True if two or more of Reuters, AP, AFP, or an official US, Israeli, or Iranian statement report a mutual ceasefire with an effective date in that window, checked at the deadline.
failure_condition: No mutually acknowledged ceasefire or armistice is reported by two or more of the listed sources with an effective date in the window.

statement: US naval forces enforcing the Iran oil-export blockade in item 97 will exchange direct fire with Iranian military or IRGC naval units, first reported between 2026-08-28 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: True if two or more of Reuters, AP, AFP, CENTCOM, or IRGC statements report a direct armed exchange tied to the blockade with a first-report date in that window, checked at the deadline.
failure_condition: No direct armed exchange between US and Iranian or IRGC naval forces is reported by two or more listed sources within the window.

statement: Austrian police will publicly name at least one arrested suspect in the 673-diamond necklace theft in item 9, reported between 2026-08-28 and 2026-10-27.
resolution: True if the Landespolizeidirektion Wien or a wire service (APA, Reuters, AP) names an arrested suspect connected to the theft with a first-report date in that window, checked at the deadline.
failure_condition: No named arrested suspect connected to the theft is reported within the window as of the deadline.

statement: A second, distinct flash-flood or lake-outburst event from the barrier lake in items 43 and 46 will hit Nepal or Tibet, separate from the flooding already reported as of 2026-08-28, between 2026-09-04 and 2026-10-15.
resolution: True if Nepal disaster authorities, Chinese state media, or two wire services report a new flood or outburst event from this barrier lake, distinct from the ongoing flooding, in that window, checked at the deadline.
failure_condition: No new, distinct flood or outburst event from this barrier lake is reported within the window as of the deadline.

statement: Incumbent Edward Markey will win the Massachusetts Democratic US Senate primary held 2026-09-01, referenced in item 127.
resolution: True if the AP declares Markey the winner, or the Massachusetts Secretary of the Commonwealth official results show Markey with the most votes, checked at the deadline.
failure_condition: The AP or official state results show a different candidate received the most votes.
